# Mark Talks Health

> Natural healing education by Mark, a health educator who lost 100 pounds and healed his gut with lifestyle changes. Each program pairs a short video course with a personalized healing app built on seven steps: fasting and cleansing, meditation and journaling, high-protein whole foods and broths, cardio and strength, music and spirit, sleep and clean air, nature and sun. Education, not medical advice; programs are designed to work alongside a doctor. Prices are in US dollars.

## Programs (one-time purchase, instant online access, 30-day money-back guarantee)

- [Gut Health Protocol](https://marktalkshealth.com/gut): $97 (regularly $147). A personalized plan with a guided green juice cleanse, the 7 healing steps, a 7-part course and a healing app. Buy on the page: https://marktalkshealth.com/gut#checkout
- [Diabetes Protocol](https://marktalkshealth.com/diabetes): $97 (regularly $147). A blood-sugar plan built around the 7 healing steps, with a 7-part course and a healing app. Buy: https://marktalkshealth.com/diabetes#checkout
- [GLP-1 Weight Loss Protocol](https://marktalkshealth.com/glp1): $97 (regularly $147). For people on or considering a GLP-1 medication: lose fat while protecting muscle, with a personalized plan, a 7-part course and an app. Buy: https://marktalkshealth.com/glp1#checkout
